'''2026 World Championship''' was the 31st annual Players Committee World Championship, held in Bloomington, Minnesota, 23–25 October 2026 (constructed 24–25 October). [[Brian Fred]] defeated [[Justin Desai]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-11-swccg-world-championship-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026/ 2026-11 SWCCG World Championship – Bloomington, Minnesota (Oct. 23-25, 2026)], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="t8">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87037 2026 World Championship Top 8], forum.starwarsccg.org</ref>

The main event is [[Open]] constructed: Day 1 Swiss (58 players, eight games, no drops), then Top 8. [[Bryan Mischke]] took the eighth Top 8 seat in a play-in game against [[Chris Wirfs]] (both 6–2).<ref name="t8" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]] (Virtual Set 27 legal)
* '''Site:''' Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 October 2026
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1598 2026 World Championship Forum]
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87042 forum t=87042]
* '''Pairings and results:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87035 forum t=87035]
